title: ConstantModelImmersionImages
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring object of condensed abelian groups. For an open immersion $j:U\to X$ of Noetherian schemes, $j_!$ takes finite constant scalar constructible $\Lambda_U$-module sheaves to such $\Lambda_X$-module sheaves. For a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ of Noetherian schemes the same holds for $i_*$. Constructibility and coefficients are [sk-def-sfb-constructible, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]; these are the actual sheaf functors of [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek, sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback].

proof.text: For zero modules use the cokernel of the identity on a rank-one free scalar module as a finitely presented zero scalar model. Every additive pullback sends zero to zero. Hence a zero sheaf has a finite constant local model on every cover. Transport existing local models through restriction isomorphisms.

For an open immersion j:U -> X choose its complementary closed immersion i:Z -> X. Concatenate the witnessing stratification on U with the one-stratum stratification on Z, obtaining a finite stratification of X. The open restriction of j!F identifies with F by the open unit. Its closed restriction vanishes: use the two adjunctions, j* i*=0, and injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence to show the identity of i* j!F is zero. Thus original models on U and zero models on Z witness constructibility of j!F.

For a closed immersion i:Z -> X concatenate the witnessing stratification on Z with the complementary open stratum. The closed restriction of i*F identifies with F by the closed counit, obtained from the abelian pro-etale counit. The complementary open restriction is zero by mixed restriction vanishing. Original models and zero models therefore witness constructibility of i*F. The same constructions cover empty loci and zero sheaves.

theorem constantModel_immersion_images
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] :
    (∀ {U X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian X]
      (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
      (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ U)),
      IsConstantModelConstructible Λ U M →
      IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X ((openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).obj M)) ∧
    (∀ {Z X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian X]
      (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
      (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Z)),
      IsConstantModelConstructible Λ Z M →
      IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X ((lowerStar Λ i).obj M))
